message: No detected untrusted source handling: There is no visible checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check when loading data from any remote or local source.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training data during preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads BERT pretrained models via ModelFactory without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; no integrity verification is performed on loaded weights.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer is a standard PyTorch optim with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or DP-SGD wrapper applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries or robustness stress tests (FGSM, PGD, Foolbox, ART) are present anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; the evaluation uses MAP@K on a single split without any integrity checks.
No detected input sanitization: The code passes raw text directly to the model (e.g., model(q1_batch_text)) with no shape, type, length, or schema validation on incoming inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (embeddings, similarity scores, loss values) are used directly with no NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds applied before returning results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although BERT-based models process text, there is no prompt-injection filtering, system-prompt isolation, or output content moderation anywhere in the visible code.
